name: Reciprocity Nudge Boomerang Effect
fact: A reciprocity-based nudge message produced a negative (boomerang) effect on compliance, compared with control conditions.
boundary: Observed in field experiments with small business owners in South Africa.

provenance.title: Encouraging tax compliance of small business owners in South Africa through nudging
provenance.quote_or_locus: the reciprocity nudge message showed a negative (boomerang) effect when compared with control conditions
